files.tests/test_policy_loader.py:
import unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import Mock
from policy_loader import load_policy


class PolicyLoaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fresh_verified_snapshot_recovers_timeout(self):
        fetch = Mock(side_effect=TimeoutError("source timeout"))
        snapshots = Mock()
        snapshots.latest_verified.return_value = SimpleNamespace(saved_at=800, rules={"mode": "safe"})
        report = Mock()
        self.assertEqual(load_policy(fetch, snapshots, 1000, report), {"mode": "safe"})
        report.assert_called_once_with("source_timeout_recovered")

    def test_stale_and_absent_snapshots_keep_timeout_visible(self):
        for snapshot in (SimpleNamespace(saved_at=699, rules={}), None):
            with self.subTest(snapshot=snapshot):
                fetch = Mock(side_effect=TimeoutError("source timeout"))
                snapshots = Mock()
                snapshots.latest_verified.return_value = snapshot
                with self.assertRaises(TimeoutError):
                    load_policy(fetch, snapshots, 1000, Mock())

    def test_success_and_other_errors_do_not_use_recovery(self):
        snapshots = Mock()
        report = Mock()
        self.assertEqual(load_policy(lambda: {"mode": "live"}, snapshots, 1000, report), {"mode": "live"})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_policy(Mock(side_effect=ValueError("invalid")), snapshots, 1000, report)
        snapshots.latest_verified.assert_not_called()
        report.assert_not_called()
